ve Filter Gas supplied Sample port (front) Filter T -connector CO2 sensor Filter < Back view > Air pump 25 NOTICE Prevention of contamination In servicing for CO2 incubator, it is important to prevent from contamination. (1)More than 90% of contamination in CO 2 incubator is caused by mold. Mold is a kind of true fungi, it has high increasing power under high temperature and high humidity. Accordingly, it is easy for mold to increase inside CO 2 incubator. Those increased mold eat up culture (mainly animal cell), eventually precious test sample will be killed. Cell that is independent from ecosystem is also independent from immune system, it has no immunocompetence at all. (2)Precautions for mold increasing There are many cases that mold is increasing by eating fat on the fingers as a source of nutrient in CO2 incubator. Therefore, cBe sure to wash and sterilize your hands prior to servicing. Use 70% ethanol. dIn installing, sterilize the inside wall and shelves after removing shelves, duct, humidifying pan and so on with 70% ethanol. (3)In the case that mold is already increasing. S

l. dIn installing, sterilize the inside wall and shelves after removing shelves, duct, humidifying pan and so on with 70% ethanol. (3)In the case that mold is already increasing. Sterilize the interior (walls) and shelves with 70% ethanol after removed all items from the chamber as same as (2)-d above. And you should sterilize again after 24 hours once sterilized, when the root of spore is geminated, because it is too difficult to remove spore of mold. Repeat sterilization is effective. In general, stainless steel is known that it is not easy (hard) to rust. However depends on the conditions, rust might generate. When you remove rust, we recommend the following agents. (1) More than 90% of contamination in CO 2 incubator is caused by mold. Mold is a kind of true fungi, it has high increasing power under high temperature

event from contamination. (1) More than 90% of contamination in CO 2 incubator is caused by mold. Mold is a kind of true fungi, it has high increasing power under high temperature and high humidity. Accordingly, it is easy for mold to increase inside CO 2 incubator. Those increased mold eat up culture (mainly animal cell), eventually precious test sample will be killed. Cell that is independent from ecosystem is also independent from immune system, it has no immunocompetence at all. (2) Precautions for mold increasing There are many cases that mold is increasing by eating fat on the fingers as a source of nutrient in CO 2 incubator. Therefore, MBe sure to wash and sterilize your hands prior to servicing. Use 70% ethanol. NIn installing, sterilize the inside wall and shelves after removing shelves, duct, humidifying pan and so on with 70% ethanol. (3) In the case that mold is already increasing. Sterilize the interior (walls) and shelves with 70% ethanol after removed all items from the chamber as same as (2)-N above. And you should sterilize again after 24 hours once sterilized, when

Mold is a kind of true fungi, it has high increasing power under high temperature and high humidity. Accordingly, it is easy for mold to increase inside CO 2 incubator. Those increased mold eat up culture (mainly animal cell), eventually precious test sample will be killed. Cell that is independent from ecosystem is also independent from immune system, it has no immunocompetence at all. 䋨2䋩㩷Precautions for mold increasing There are many cases that mold is increasing by eating fat on the fingers as a source of nutrient in CO2 incubator. Therefore, 㽲㩷Be sure to wash and sterilize your hands prior to servicing. Use 70䋦 ethanol. 㽳㩷In installing, sterilize the inside wall and shelves after removing shelves, duct, humidifying pan and so on with 70% ethanol. 䋨3䋩㩷In the case that mold is already increasing. Sterilize

talling, sterilize the inside wall and shelves after removing shelves, duct, humidifying pan and so on with 70% ethanol. 䋨3䋩㩷In the case that mold is already increasing. Sterilize the interior (walls) and shelves with 70% ethanol after removed all items from the chamber as same as (2)-㽳 above. And you should sterilize again after 24 hours once sterilized, when the root of spore is geminated, because it is too difficult to remove spore of mold. Repeat sterilization is effective. The principle can be explained as follows; The air flow inside duct is top down, and the part of two holes connected to the IR sensor via tubes is negative pressure. And the air inside tube is drawn from the lower hole because there is the difference in the pressure level of two holes due to the pressure loss inside chamber duct, and the pressure around the upper hole is more negative than one around the lower hole. It is sure that the air inside chamber constantly flows to the IR sensor and is measured its CO2 level with the IR sensor timely because the CO2 recovery speed of MCO-19AIC is same as that of MCO-18AIC. 㻌 IR sensor BOX IR sensor 58 Mechanism for Double wavelength IR sensor 㩷 㩷 㩷 㩷 㩷 㩷 㩷 㩷 㩷 㩷 㩷 㩷 㩷 㩷 㩷 㩷 㩷 㩷 㩷 㩷 㩷 㩷 Double wavelength (4.0 㱘m adding to 4.3 㱘m) are measured simultaneously in this IR sensor. Mold is a kind of true fungi, it has high increasing power under high temperature and high humidity. Accordingly, it is easy for mold to increase inside CO 2 incubator. Those increased mold eat up culture (mainly animal cell), eventually precious test sample will be killed. Cell that is independent from ecosystem is also independent from immune system, it has no immunocompetence at all. （2） Precautions for mold increasing There are many cases that mold is increasing by eating fat on the fingers as a source of nutrient in CO 2 incubator. Therefore, ① Be sure to wash and sterilize your hands prior to servicing. Use 70％ ethanol. ② In installing, sterilize the inside wall and shelves after removing shelves, duct, humidifying pan and so on with 70% ethanol. （3） In the case that mold is already increasing. Sterilize the interior (walls) and shelves with 70%

elves after removing shelves, duct, humidifying pan and so on with 70% ethanol. （3） In the case that mold is already increasing. Sterilize the interior (walls) and shelves with 70% ethanol after removed all items from the chamber as same as (2)-② above. And you should sterilize again after 24 hours once sterilized, when the root of spore is geminated, because it is too difficult to remove spore of mold. Repeat sterilization is effective. (Refer to the timing chart below). （1） Mechanism of auto zero adjustment. 〇Run the auto zero pump for two minutes to feed ambient air into CO 2 sensor. During this period, sampling air pump is off. CO 2 density in the atmosphere is almost 0% (0.03%～0.07％), adjust automatically that the measured CO2 is 0%. 〇Then do usual sampling for two minutes, compare CO2 density of the ambient air with the inside of the chamber. At this time, only air pump for sampling from the chamber is running. （2） Timing chart of auto zero adjustment （3） Indication of auto zero adjustment During auto zero adjustment, indicator of CO 2 density is locked as the density, which is immediate before the auto zero adjustment, is displayed and the decimal point of the indicator is flashing. Power failure (1) Detection: A unit will check a voltage supplied from switching power supply to main PCB in every 480msec. If the voltage is lower than 2V, it is diagnosed that the unit is in power failure. (2) Actions during power failure: - Co

from switching power supply to main PCB in every 480msec. If the voltage is lower than 2V, it is diagnosed that the unit is in power failure. (2) Actions during power failure: - Compressor turns off. - LEDs go off and buzzer sounds intermittently. - Chamber temperature is displayed for 5 seconds and buzzer stops sounding by pressing BUZZER key. Buzzer will sound again after Ring back time elapses. 3. Sensors (1) Temp. sensor: The purpose is to detect chamber temperature. It is installed on the upper area of evaporator at the top inner cabinet. (2) Comp. sensor: The purpose is to detect compressor temperature. It is installed on the discharging pipe at the cooling unit base ass’y. (3) AT sensor: The purpose is to detect ambient room temperature. It is installed in the electric box. Delay time is changeable between 0 and 15 minutes. If you set delay time to “0” minute, temperature alarm will be

t deviates from setting range for being temperature alarm active. Delay time is changeable between 0 and 15 minutes. If you set delay time to “0” minute, temperature alarm will be active without delay (with 1 second actually). Temperature alarm delay time is settable in F50. (3) For compressor start: There has delay time for starting compressor because it is necessary to keep the pressure lower than the fixed. <Delay time when start-up> It is settable in F05. <Delay time when cycle running> It is 2minutes fixed. 5. Temperature control Chamber temperature is controlled by turning compressor on/off. When a temp. sensor temperature is equal to set temperature, compressor will turn on. When a temp. sensor temperature is lower than set temperature -0.6 䉝, compressor will turn off. 6. Fan motor control Ambient temperature affects to an operation of condensing fan motor. When an ambient temperature is equal or higher than 25 䉝, condensing fan motor will be simultaneously active with compressor. When an ambient temperature is 24.5 to 25 䉝 and it is getting colder, condensing fan motor will b

her than 25 䉝, condensing fan motor will be simultaneously active with compressor. When an ambient temperature is 24.5 to 25 䉝 and it is getting colder, condensing fan motor will be simultaneously active with compressor. When an ambient temperature is 24.5 to 25 䉝 and it is getting warmer, condensing fan motor will be always inactive. When an ambient temperature is equal or lower than 24.5 䉝, condensing fan motor will be always inactive. 7. (Criterion: Value in current transformer A / value in current transformer B = +/- 15%) 㽴 If unit continues the status of 㽳 for more than 5 minutes, it is diagnosed as abnormal. 㽵 If unit is diagnosed as an abnormal, fan motor protection (*1) activates. 㽶 For the prevention of misdiagnosis, condensing fan motor relay is forced to activate after 1 hour has

Fan motor lock Abnormalities in condensing fan motor can be detected by current in condensing fan motor A/B. (1) Abnormalities in condensing fan motor will be detected by the difference between cu

bnormalities in condensing fan motor can be detected by current in condensing fan motor A/B. (1) Abnormalities in condensing fan motor will be detected by the difference between currents in fan motor A and B. Criterion: (Current in fan motor A) / (Current in fan motor B) 䍺15% Diagnosis: When a value obtained from the calculation is deviate from the criterion after 2 minutes elapse since the power is supplied, it is considered as “Fan motor is locked”. Current leakage or electric shock may result if the unit is exposed to rain water. Only qualified engineers or service personnel should install the unit. The installation by unqualified personnel may cause electric shock or fire. Install the unit on a sturdy floor and take an adequate precaution to prevent the unit from turning over. vent the unit from turning over. If the floor is not strong enough or the installation site is not adequate, this may result in injury from the unit falling or tipping over. Never install the unit in a flammable or volatile location. This may cause explosion or fire.
